**Finding: compliant** (GOVLAW — Governing law and venue)

§ 14.3 governs the Agreement by the substantive laws of the State of New York — our preferred position. There is no arbitration clause anywhere in the document and no foreign or IBM-home-jurisdiction venue, so no walk-away exposure exists. The clause is silent on venue rather than granting exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County; that is a minor gap short of the preferred wording, noted rather than redlined, since New York law is selected and no competing forum is designated. §§ 14.4 (jury waiver) and 14.14 (limitations period) are related but noted only, not double-flagged here. No redline proposed.
